email_subject: Application - Influencer Marketing Internship at Adshot
email_body:
Dear Adshot team,

I'm writing to apply for the Influencer Marketing Internship at Adshot. As a digital marketer with a technical background, I've built and optimized websites for traditional and AI-powered search, and I'm eager to bring that mix of creativity and analysis to Belgium's leading influencer agency.

I have hands-on experience with social media channels, particularly Instagram and TikTok, through managing content for client websites and my own projects. My work at Episto involves SEO content and CMS management, where I've seen how influencer collaborations can amplify organic reach. I'm also proficient in Canva and have a basic understanding of video editing, which I believe will be valuable in creating engaging influencer campaigns.

Adshot's innovative approach, from being a TikTok CCX Partner to working with top brands, excites me. I'm a quick learner who thrives in independent, horizontal structures, and I'm ready to take responsibility from day one.

I've attached my resume for your review. I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute to your team.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
baverok.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok
cover_letter:
Dear Adshot team,

I'm applying for the Influencer Marketing Internship at Adshot because I want to learn how influencer campaigns are built from the ground up at one of Belgium's leading agencies. My background is in digital marketing with a technical edge: I build and optimize websites for search, write content that ranks, and use AI tools to automate repetitive work. That mix of creative and analytical thinking is exactly what I'd bring to your team.

While my CV doesn't list direct influencer marketing experience, I've spent the past year managing social media content and SEO for client websites at Episto, where I've seen how influencer collaborations can drive organic growth. I'm fluent in Instagram and TikTok, and I've used Canva extensively for visual content. I'm also comfortable with video editing basics and eager to develop those skills further. My freelance work on baverok.com and mirook.com shows I can work independently, take ownership of projects, and deliver measurable results—qualities Adshot values in its horizontal structure.

What draws me to Adshot is your pioneering spirit: being one of the first Belgian agencies to work with Twitch streamers and TikTok creators, and your TikTok CCX Partner status. I want to be part of a team that's shaping the influencer landscape, and I'm ready to contribute from day one. I'm organized, curious, and not afraid to ask questions or propose ideas.

I've attached my resume and would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my skills can support Adshot's clients. Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
• Proficient in Instagram and TikTok, with hands-on experience managing social media content for client websites and personal projects.
• Skilled in Canva for visual content creation; basic video editing knowledge, eager to develop further.
• Independent worker with a freelance background, capable of taking ownership and delivering results in a horizontal structure.
• Digital marketing experience at Episto, including SEO content and CMS management, with insight into how influencer collaborations amplify organic reach.
• Technical background in web development and AI tools, enabling creative and analytical approaches to influencer campaigns.
